map.0–50 优、51–100 良、101–150 轻度、151–200 中度、20: 0 to 50 excellent, 51 to 100 good, 101 to 150 mild, 151 to 200 moderate, 201 to 300 severe, above 300 very severe; sensitive groups should pay attention from 100 upward.
map.AQI = 逐污染物分段线性插值: AQI = piecewise linear interpolation per pollutant
map.AQI 为什么取最大值？: Why Does the AQI Take the Maximum?
map.AQI 分几级？: How Many Levels Does the AQI Have?
map.AQI 取各污染物 IAQI 的最大值，代表「最差那项」对健康的风险，首要污染物: The AQI takes the maximum IAQI across pollutants, representing the health risk of "the worst one", and that pollutant is the primary pollutant.
map.→ 打开空气质量AQI计算工具: -> Open the Air Quality AQI Calculation tool
map.对照 AQI 给健康出行建议。: Give health and travel advice against the AQI.
map.由 PM2.5/PM10/SO₂ 等浓度算 IAQI 分指数取最大得 AQI。: Compute the IAQI sub-indices from concentrations such as PM2.5/PM10/SO₂ and take the maximum to obtain the AQI.
map.识别首要污染物与超标等级。: Identify the primary pollutant and the exceedance level.
map.输入六项污染物浓度，按 HJ 633-2012 标准逐项计算 IAQI 并取最大: Enter the six pollutant concentrations, compute the IAQI for each per the HJ 633-2012 standard and take the maximum to obtain the AQI. Units: μg/m³ (CO in mg/m³).
map.：PM2.5=35、PM10=50 时各 IAQI=50，AQI=50（优），无: : when PM2.5=35 and PM10=50, each gives IAQI=50 and AQI=50 (excellent), with no primary pollutant, so normal outdoor activity is fine.
map.：PM2.5=75 μg/m³：落在分段(35,75]→(50,100)，IAQ: : PM2.5=75 μg/m³ falls in the segment (35,75]→(50,100), giving IAQI=50+(75−35)/(75−35)×(100−50)=100; PM10=50→IAQI=50. AQI=max=100 (good), with PM2.5 as the primary pollutant.
